name: hyprspace
label: Hyprspace macOS Overview
description: macOS Mission Control-inspired workspace overview panel with live interactive window manipulation.

options.label: Panel Background Color
options.description: Color and transparency of the overview header strip.

options.label: Active Workspace Border
options.description: Border color highlighting the currently active workspace preview.

options.label: Inactive Workspace Border
options.description: Border color of background workspace thumbnails.

options.label: Panel Height (px)
options.description: Height in pixels of the workspace thumbnail strip.

options.label: Dragging Opacity
options.description: Window opacity while dragging between workspaces in overview.

options.label: Place Panel At Bottom
options.description: Render the workspace strip at the bottom of the screen instead of top.

options.label: Show Empty Workspaces
options.description: Display empty workspaces in the top overview strip.

options.label: Exit Overview On Click
options.description: Exit overview mode immediately when clicking a window or workspace.
